# REM Framework Phase 5 / Task 1 — Multi-Axis Identity Oscillator Verification

ConfigurationStatus: VALID

Control classification: IN_PHASE_BODY_DIAGONAL_CONTROL. This verifies an in-phase vector along (1,1,1) or (-1,-1,-1); it is not interpreted as isotropic motion.

All 36 updates are recorded in `oscillator-cycle.csv`. Every update satisfied X=Y=Z excitation and `magnitude=sqrt(x²+y²+z²)=sqrt(3)*abs(x)` within 1e-12. Each axis advanced exactly once per update and wrapped from 340 to 0 at +360 degrees; an auxiliary cloned-Identity audit also verified the -360-to-0 wrap. No first divergence occurred.

## Source application

The small 11³ compact lattice used an unindented R=4 Extended Identity. The audit sampled four occupied nodes: center, axis-region, face-diagonal-region, and body-diagonal-region. One Identity excitation was generated per update, then applied coherently to the entire source. All 144 sampled applications matched exactly; see `source-force-audit.csv`. Extended Identity node count never advanced oscillator phase.

## Z-only regression

A separate small-lattice control loaded the unchanged canonical V2 Z-only configuration. For 36 updates, direct-vector application `(excitation.x, excitation.y, excitation.z)` matched the existing `(0,0,excitation.z)` path exactly.

## Scope

No R=96 run, detector measurement, Emax, MAD, StdDev, shape change, indentation, phase optimization, or frequency optimization was performed.
